images.revised_prompt:
Create exactly one vertical 9:16 realistic commercial photograph using the attached image as the identity and scene anchor. Preserve the same fictional adult East Asian woman exactly: identical face, facial proportions, dark eyes, natural skin texture with visible real pores, black hair in the same low bun, ivory silk robe with modest neckline, no jewelry. Upper-body framing in the same restrained evening vanity setting: walnut vanity, dark slate/stone accents, blurred autumn leaves outside a large window, cool blue-hour city dusk, warm amber practical light from screen left, rich navy and gold palette.

Moment: she has completed a gentle head turn and now slightly inclines her head while lowering her eyes toward a small ampoule positioned just below the bottom edge of the frame, outside the visible crop. The ampoule/product must not be visible or implied as a visible object in frame. Calm, quiet evening-ritual expression. Hands remain relaxed at the edge of the vanity in the same pose and placement as the reference. Keep the vanity surface completely clear.

Do not change her identity, age, hairstyle, robe, lighting mood, or environment. No bottle, jar, tube, carton, cosmetic package, or any product anywhere in frame. No text, captions, logo, watermark, collage, grid, or alternate variations. Single clean photographic frame.
